n = int(input())
b = int(input())
array = [int(input()) for _ in range(n)]

totalCount = 0
startIdx = 0
evenCount = 0
oddCount = 0
diffList = []

for index in range(n):
    if array[index] % 2 == 0:
        evenCount += 1
    else:
        oddCount += 1
    if evenCount == oddCount and index != n - 1:
        diff = abs(array[index + 1] - array[startIdx])
        diffList.append(diff)
        startIdx = index + 1
        evenCount = 0
        oddCount = 0

if diffList:
    diffList.sort()
    sum_diff = 0
    for i, diff in enumerate(diffList):
        sum_diff += diff
        if sum_diff > b:
            totalCount = i
            break
        else:
            totalCount = i + 1
else:
    if n > 0:
        diff = abs(array[0] - array[0])
        if diff >= b:
            totalCount = 1

print(totalCount)
